title: preview popup’s child popup doesn’t spawn at the correct place if parent was moved
line: After you move a folder preview popup, the popups for folders inside it now open next to it instead of where it used to be.
explanation: Child preview popups are placed from their parent popup's window position, but on Wayland a client is never told where the compositor moved its window, so after a Meta+drag the parent still believed it was at its original spot and the child opened there. The change makes popups opened from inside another preview popup ask KWin to open them at the cursor (plasma-shell open_under_cursor), which is on the hovered folder in the parent's real position; top-level popups from the desktop keep their current placement.

commits.message:
folder: open nested preview popups under the cursor on Wayland

A preview popup moved by the user doesn't learn its new position on
Wayland, so its child popups opened next to where it used to be. Ask the
compositor to place popups opened from another popup at the cursor.

BUG: 506447

compositor to place popups opened from another popup at the cursor.

 CMakeLists.txt                                     |  6 ++----
 containments/desktop/plugins/folder/CMakeLists.txt | 10 +++++++++-
 containments/desktop/plugins/folder/subdialog.cpp  | 10 ++++++++++
 3 files changed, 21 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/CMakeLists.txt b/CMakeLists.txt
index 06d26b072f..ad5809f34c 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -52,10 +52,7 @@ find_package(Qt6 ${QT_MIN_VERSION} CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS
 )
 
 find_package(Qt6GuiPrivate ${QT_MIN_VERSION} REQUIRED NO_MODULE)
-
-if(BUILD_KCM_TABLET)
-    find_package(Qt6WaylandClient ${QT_MIN_VERSION} CONFIG REQUIRED)
-endif()
+find_package(Qt6WaylandClient ${QT_MIN_VERSION} CONFIG REQUIRED)
 
 find_package(KF6 ${KF6_MIN_VERSION} REQUIRED COMPONENTS
     Auth
@@ -86,6 +83,7 @@ find_package(KF6 ${KF6_MIN_VERSION} REQUIRED COMPONENTS
 find_package(Plasma5Support ${PROJECT_DEP_VERSION} REQUIRED)
 find_package(Plasma ${PROJECT_DEP_VERSION} REQUIRED)
 find_package(PlasmaQuick ${PROJECT_DEP_VERSION} REQUIRED)
+find_package(PlasmaWaylandProtocols 1.22.0 REQUIRED)
 find_package(PlasmaActivities ${PROJECT_DEP_VERSION} REQUIRED)
 find_package(PlasmaActivitiesStats ${PROJECT_DEP_VERSION} REQUIRED)
 find_package(PolkitQt6-1 REQUIRED)
diff --git a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/CMakeLists.txt b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/CMakeLists.txt
index 9ddc1fc400..f564400a94 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -39,7 +39,15 @@ target_link_libraries(folderplugin PUBLIC
                       Plasma::PlasmaQuick
                       KF6::ConfigGui
                       KF6::Notifications
-                      KF6::XmlGui)
+                      KF6::WindowSystem
+                      KF6::XmlGui
+                      Qt::WaylandClient)
+
+qt_generate_wayland_protocol_client_sources(folderplugin
+    PRIVATE_CODE
+    FILES
+        "${PLASMA_WAYLAND_PROTOCOLS_DIR}/plasma-shell.xml"
+)
 
 ecm_qt_declare_logging_category(folderplugin
     HEADER debug.h
diff --git a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/subdialog.cpp b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/subdialog.cpp
index cd438b49d1..bfbf189200 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/subdialog.cpp
+++ b/containments/desktop/plugins/folder/subdialog.cpp
@@ -10,9 +10,19 @@
 #include <QGuiApplication>
 #include <QScreen>
 
+#include <KWindowSystem>
+#include <PlasmaQuick/PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration>
+
 SubDialog::SubDialog(QQuickItem *parent)
     : PlasmaQuick::Dialog(parent)
 {
+    // On Wayland, a parent popup moved by the user doesn't know its new position,
+    // so let the compositor place nested popups at the cursor instead.
+    connect(this, &PlasmaQuick::Dialog::visualParentChanged, this, [this] {
+        if (KWindowSystem::isPlatformWayland() && visualParent() && qobject_cast<SubDialog *>(visualParent()->window())) {
+            PlasmaShellWaylandIntegration::get(this)->openUnderCursor();
+        }
+    });
 }
 
 SubDialog::~SubDialog()
